policy.minimum_evidence: For every new tournament, obtain game-level records with event, round, both players, both teams, both factions, both force dispositions and 20-0 scores; source URL per record.
policy.event_scope: Check all teams and all rounds for completeness. Partial samples must not appear in the default global matchup statistics; explicitly label provisional sets.
policy.missing_fields: Map/terrain and detachments remain null unless sourced, never inferred.
policy.verification: Record count, duplicate conflicts, impossible score pairs, unmatched games and missing rounds must be audited before dataset release.
